字段选项（如下拉框选项）\n\n### 辅助视图和函数\n\n#### WorkflowMappingView 视图\n\n提供工作流配置和字段映射的联合查询视图。\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE VIEW \"WorkflowMappingView\" AS\nSELECT \n    wc.\"workflowType\",\n    wc.\"name\" as wfm.\"defaultValue\",\n    wfm.\"label\",\n    wfm.\"placeholder\",\n    wfm.\"helpText\",\n    wfm.\"displayOrder\",\n    wfm.\"isVisible\",\n    wfm.\"validationRules\",\n    wfm.\"fieldOptions\"\nFROM \"WorkflowConfiguration\" wc\nJOIN \"WorkflowFieldMapping\" wfm ON wc.\"workflowType\" = wfm.\"workflowType\" \n    AND wc.\"version\" = wfm.\"workflowVersion\"\nWHERE wc.\"isActive\" = true\nORDER BY wfm.\"workflowType\", wfm.\"displayOrder\";\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 查询函数\n\n**get_workflow_mappings()** - 获取工作流字段映射\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION         "contents": "const FieldMappingManagementPage: React.FC = \n\n  const [customModules, setCustomModules] = useState&lt;Array&lt;{ id: string; label: string }&gt;&gt;([]);\n\n  // localStorage key for custom modules\n  const CUSTOM_MODULES_STORAGE_KEY = 'field-mapping-custom-modules';\n\n  // 从localStorage加载自定义模块\n  const loadCustomModulesFromStorage = (): Array&lt;{ id: string; label: string }&gt; =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const stored = localStorage.getItem(CUSTOM_MODULES_STORAGE_KEY);\n      if (stored) {\n        const parsed = JSON.parse(stored);\n        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {\n          return parsed.filter((m: any) =&gt; m &amp;&amp; m.id &amp;&amp; m.label);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn('加载自定义模块失败:', error);\n    }\n    return [];\n  };\n\n  // 保存自定义模块到localStorage\n  const saveCustomModulesToStorage = (modules: Array&lt;{ id: string; label: string }&gt;) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      localStorage.setItem(CUSTOM_MODULES_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(modules));\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn('保存自定义模块失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const toggleFeatureChecked = (key: string) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedFeatureTypes(prev =&gt; prev.includes(key) ? prev.filter(k =&gt; k !== key) : [...prev, key]);\n  };\n\n  const isFeatureChecked = (key: string) =&gt; selectedFeatureTypes.includes(key);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadData();\n    // 加载已保存的自定义模块\n    const savedModules = loadCustomModulesFromStorage();\n    if (savedModules.length &gt; 0) {\n      setCustomModules(savedModules);\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  const FEATURE_LABELS: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n    'ai-dialog': 'AI对话框',\n    'five-view-analysis': '五看',\n    'three-fix-analysis': '三定',\n    'tech-matrix': '技术矩阵',\n    'propagation-strategy': '传播',\n    'exhibition-video': '展具与视频',\n    'translation': '翻译',\n    'ppt-outline': '技术讲稿',\n    'script': '脚本',\n  };\n\n  const FEATURE_PAGE_MAP: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n    'ai-dialog': '技术包装'\n,\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\n\n\n  async execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const userMessageRecord = await this.aiSearchService.sendMessage(\n        params.conversationId,\n        'user',\n        params.content,\n        params.sources || [],\n        params.files || []\n      );\n\n      const conversationRecord = await this.aiSearchService.getConversation(params.conversationId);\n\n      try {\n        const requestedWorkflowId = params.workflowId;\n        const finalWorkflowId = requestedWorkflowId || await resolveWorkflowId();\n\n        if (!finalWorkflowId) {\n          return success({\n            userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n            error: '未找到可用的工作流配置',\n          });\n        }\n\n        const mappingConfig = await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, finalWorkflowId);\n\n        if (!mappingConfig) {\n          const message =\n            requestedWorkflowId &amp;&amp; requestedWorkflowId === finalWorkflowId\n              ?         "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nasync execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n\n        const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, mappingConfig.inputMappings);\n\n        // 获取对话的 Dify conversation_id（如果存在），用于多轮对话\n        const difyConversationId = conversationRecord?.difyConversationId || null;\n        \n        logger.info('准备发送消息到Dify工作流', {\n          本地对话ID: params.conversationId,\n          DifyConversationId: difyConversationId || '未设置（首次对话，Dify将返回新的conversation_id）',\n        });\n        \n        // 将 Dify conversation_id 添加到 workflowInput 中，这样 Agent 节点可以获取到\n        if (difyConversationId) {\n          workflowInput.conversationId = difyConversationId;\n          logger.info('已设置Dify conversation_id到工作流输入', { difyConversationId });\n        } else {\n          logger.info('首次对话，未设置Dify conversation_id，Dify将创建新的对话');\n        }\n\n        const workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(finalWorkflowId, {\n          input: workflowInput,\n        });\n\n        // 从工作流执行结果中提取 Dify conversation_id\n        // Agent 节点的输出中可能包含 conversation_id\n        let newDifyConversationId: string | null = null;\n        \n        // 尝试从工作流执行结果的数据中提取 conversation_id\n        // 首先检查 outputs 中是否包含 conversation_id\n        const workflowData = (workflowResult as any)?.data;\n        if (workflowData?.outputs) {\n          const outputs = workflowData.outputs as any;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "class AiSearchService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 发送消息\n   */\n  async sendMessage(\n    conversationId: string,\n    request: SendMessageRequest\n  ): Promise&lt;{ userMessage: Message; aiMessage?: Message; error?: string; errorDetail?: string }&gt; {\n    try {\n      const formData = new FormData();\n      formData.append('content', request.content);\n      if (request.sources) {\n        formData.append('sources', JSON.stringify(request.sources));\n      }\n      if (request.files) {\n        request.files.forEach((file) =&gt; {\n          formData.append('files', file);\n        });\n      }\n      if (request.workflowId) {\n        formData.append('workflowId', request.workflowId);\n      }\n      if (typeof request.contextWindowSize === 'number') {\n        formData.append('contextWindowSize', String(request.contextWindowSize));\n      }\n      if (request.fileList) {\n        formData.append('fileList', request.fileList);\n      }\n      if (request.knowledgeBaseNames) {\n        formData.append('knowledgeBaseNames', request.knowledgeBaseNames);\n      }\n\n      const response = await api.post(\n        &#96;/ai-search/conversations/${conversationId}/messages&#96;,\n        formData,\n        {\n          headers: {\n            'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data',\n          },\n        }\n      );\n\n      if\n  }",

        "contents": "export const mapWorkflowInput = (\n  data: any,\n  inputMappings?: any[]\n) =&gt; {\n  if (inputMappings &amp;&amp; inputMappings.length &gt; 0) {\n    const mapped = fieldMappingEngine.mapInputFields(data, inputMappings);\n    \n    // 确保关键字段始终被保留（即使映射配置中没有配置）\n    // 这些字段对于附件传递至关重要\n    if (data.sources &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(data.sources)) {\n      mapped.sources = data.sources;\n      logger.info('mapWorkflowInput: 保留 sources 字段', {\n        sourcesCount: data.sources.length,\n        sources: data.sources.map((s: any) =&gt; ({\n          id: s.id,\n          title: s.title,\n          type: s.type,\n          hasUrl: !!s.url,\n          url: s.url,\n        })),\n      });\n    }\n    if (data.files &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(data.files)) {\n      mapped.files = data.files;\n      logger.info('mapWorkflowInput: 保留 files 字段', {\n        filesCount: data.files.length,\n      });\n    }\n    if (data.fileList &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(data.fileList)) {\n      mapped.fileList = data.fileList;\n      logger.info('mapWorkflowInput: 保留 fileList 字段', {\n        fileListCount: data.fileList.length,\n      });\n    }\n    \n    // 确保 query 字段存在（即使映射配置中没有）\n    if (!mapped.query &amp;&amp; data.query) {\n      mapped.query = data.query;\n    }\n    \n    logger.info('mapWorkflowInput: 映射完成', {\n      hasInputMappings: true,\n      mappedKeys: Object.keys(mapped),\n      hasSources: !!mapped.sources,\n      sourcesCount: Array.isArray(mapped.sources) ? mapped.sources.length : 0,\n      hasFiles: !!mapped.files,\n      filesCount: Array.isArray(mapped.files) ? mapped.files.length : 0,\n      hasFileList: !!mapped.fileList,\n      fileListCount: Array.isArray(mapped.fileList) ? mapped.fileList.length : 0,\n    });\n    \n    return mapped;\n  }\n  // 如果没有映射配置，直接返回数据，但确保 query 字段存在\n  const result = { ...data };\n  if (!result.query &amp;&amp; data.query) {\n    result.query = data.query;\n  }\n  \n  logger.info\n\n;",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\nasync execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n      if (!featureConfig) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'FEATURE_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: &#96;未找到功能对象映射配置: ${dto.featureType}&#96;,\n        });\n      }\n\n      // 优先使用 agentId（AI角色ID），如果没有再使用 workflowId\n      // agentId 用于直接调用 AI 角色，workflowId 用于通过工作流调用\n      const configuredAgentId = (featureConfig as any).agentId;\n      const configuredWorkflowId = featureConfig.workflowId;\n      \n      // 如果配置了 agentId，使用它；否则使用 workflowId\n      // 注意：只有当 agentId 是不同的角色时才使用它，避免使用当前工作流\n      let targetWorkflowId: string;\n      if (configuredAgentId &amp;&amp; configuredAgentId !== workflowId) {\n        targetWorkflowId = configuredAgentId;\n        logger.info('使用配置的 AI 角色', {\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\n          agentId: configuredAgentId,\n        });\n      } else if (configuredWorkflowId &amp;&amp; configuredWorkflowId !== workflowId) {\n        targetWorkflowId = configuredWorkflowId;\n        logger.info('使用配置的工作流', {\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\n          workflowId: configuredWorkflowId,\n        });\n      } else {\n        targetWorkflowId = workflowId;\n        logger.warn('功能对象未配置专属 agentId 或 workflowId，将使用当前工作流', {\n          featureType: dto.featureType,\n          fallbackWorkflowId: workflowId,\n          configuredAgentId,\n          configuredWorkflowId,\n        });\n      }\n      const targetMappingConfig = targetWorkflowId === workflowId\n        ? baseMappingConfig\n        : await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, targetWorkflowId);\n\n      const effectiveInputMappings = featureConfig.inputMappings?.length\n        ? featureConfig.inputMappings\n        : targetMappingConfig?.inputMappings || [];\n\n      const effectiveOutputMappings = featureConfig.outputMappings?.length\n;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nasync execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n        // 记录保存的消息内容\n        logger.info('保存AI消息', {\n          workflowId: finalWorkflowId,\n          content: aiContent,\n          contentLength: aiContent.length,\n          outputsContent: cleanExtractedOutput.content,\n          outputsKeys: Object.keys(cleanExtractedOutput),\n        });\n\n        const aiMessageRecord = await this.aiSearchService.sendMessage(\n          params.conversationId,\n          'assistant',\n          aiContent,\n          params.sources || [],\n          [],\n          cleanExtractedOutput\n        );\n        \n        logger.info('AI消息已保存', {\n          messageId: aiMessageRecord.id,\n          content: aiMessageRecord.content,\n          contentLength: aiMessageRecord.content?.length || 0,\n        });\n\n        return success({\n          userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n          aiMessage: formatMessageRecord(aiMessageRecord),\n        });\n      } catch (workflowError: any) {\n        logger.error('工作流执行失败', { workflowError });\n        return success({\n          userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n          error: '工作流执行失败，请稍后重试',\n          errorDetail: workflowError?.message || String(workflowError),\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('发送消息失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'SEND_MESSAGE_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '发送消息失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取功能类型的中文标签\n   */\n  private getFeatureLabel(featureType: string): string {\n    const labelMap: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n      'five-view-analysis': '五看分析'\n,\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\n\n\n  async execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const conversation = await this.aiSearchService.getConversation(conversationId);\n      if (!conversation) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: '对话不存在',\n        });\n      }\n\n      const requestedWorkflowId = dto.workflowId;\n      const workflowId = requestedWorkflowId || await resolveWorkflowId();\n      if (!workflowId) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: '未找到可用的工作流配置',\n        });\n      }\n\n      let targetSources = Array.isArray(dto.sources) ? dto.sources : conversation.sources || [];\n\n      const baseMappingConfig = await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, workflowId);\n      if (!baseMappingConfig) {\n        const message =\n          requestedWorkflowId &amp;&amp; requestedWorkflowId === workflowId\n            ? &#96;所选工作流(${workflowId})尚未配置字段映射&#96;\n            : '尚未配置字段映射，请先完成字段映射配置';\n        return failure({\n          code: 'MAPPING_NOT_FOUND',\n          message,\n        });\n      }\n\n      const featureConfig = baseMappingConfig.featureObjects?.find(\n        (f: FeatureObjectMapping) =&gt; f.featureType === dto.featureType\n      );\n\n      // 调试日志：检查功能对象配置\n      logger.info('查找功能对象配置', {\n        featureType: dto.featureType,\n        allFeatureObjects: baseMappingConfig.featureObjects?.map((f: any) =&gt; ({\n          featureType: f.featureType,\n          workflowId: f.workflowId,\n          pageType: f.pageType,\n        })),\n        foundConfig: featureConfig ? {\n          featureType: featureConfig.featureType,\n          workflowId: featureConfig.workflowId,\n        } : null,\n      });\n\n      if (!featureConfig) {\n        return\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "describe('SendMessageUseCase', () =&gt; {\n  const aiSearchService = {\n    sendMessage: vi.fn(),\n    getMessageById: vi.fn(),\n  } as any;\n\n  const fieldMappingService = {\n    getFieldMappingConfig: vi.fn(),\n  } as any;\n\n  const useCase = new SendMessageUseCase(aiSearchService, fieldMappingService);\n\n  const mockedWorkflowService = agentWorkflowService as unknown as {\n    executeWorkflow: ReturnType&lt;typeof vi.fn&gt;;\n    getAllWorkflows: ReturnType&lt;typeof vi.fn&gt;;\n  };\n\n  beforeEach(() =&gt; {\n    vi.clearAllMocks();\n    mockedWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows.mockReturnValue([\n      { id: 'flow-1', name: '智能工作流' },\n    ]);\n    mockedWorkflowService.executeWorkflow.mockResolvedValue({ message: 'AI 回复' });\n  });\n\n  it('should create user message and ai reply successfully', async () =&gt; {\n    aiSearchService.sendMessage\n      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'user-1', role: 'user', content: 'hello', created_at: new Date().toISOString() })\n      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'ai-1', role: 'assistant', content: 'AI 回复', created_at: new Date().toISOString() });\n\n    fieldMappingService.getFieldMappingConfig.mockResolvedValue({\n      inputMappings: [],\n      outputMappings: [],\n    });\n\n    const result = await useCase.execute({\n      conversationId: 'conv-1',\n      content: 'hello',\n    });\n\n    expect(result.success).toBe(true);\n    if (result.success) {\n      expect(result.value.aiMessage?.content).toBe('AI 回复');\n    }\n  });\n});",

        "contents": "const WorkflowPage: React.FC = \nconst getStepDifyConfig = \n workflowConfigs],\n  );\n\n  const handleSendMessage = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    if (!inputMessage.trim()) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const userMessage = {\n      id: Date.now().toString(),\n      type: \"user\" as const,\n      content: inputMessage,\n      timestamp: new Date(),\n    };\n\n    const messageContext = [...chatMessages, userMessage];\n\n    addUserMessage(inputMessage);\n    setInputMessage(\"\");\n    setIsTyping(true);\n\n    try {\n      let smartSearchConfig = getStepDifyConfig(\"smartSearch\");\n\n      if (!smartSearchConfig) {\n        const refreshedDifyConfigs = await configService.getDifyConfigs();\n        const refreshedWorkflowConfigs = await configService.getWorkflowConfigs();\n\n        setDifyConfigs(refreshedDifyConfigs);\n        setWorkflowConfigs(refreshedWorkflowConfigs);\n\n        const workflowConfig = refreshedWorkflowConfigs.find((item) =&gt; item.stepKey === \"smartSearch\");\n        if (workflowConfig) {\n          smartSearchConfig =\n            refreshedDifyConfigs.find((item) =&gt; item.id === workflowConfig.difyConfigId) ?? null;\n        }\n\n        if (!smartSearchConfig) {\n          const defaultConfig = await configService.getDifyConfig(\"default-ai-search\");\n          if (defaultConfig &amp;&amp; defaultConfig.enabled) {\n            smartSearchConfig = defaultConfig;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\n        inputMessage,\n        {\n          context: messageContext.map((msg) =&gt; ({\n            role: msg.type === \"user\" ? \"user\" : \"assistant\",\n            content: msg.content,\n          })),\n        },\n        smartSearchConfig &amp;&amp; smartSearchConfig.enabled ? smartSearchConfig : undefined,\n        conversationId || undefined,\n      );\n\n      let responseContent = \"抱歉，我无法处理您的请求。\";\n\n      if (result.success &amp;&amp; result.data)\n  }\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\nasync execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n\n\n      const effectiveOutputMappings = featureConfig.outputMappings?.length\n        ? featureConfig.outputMappings\n        : targetMappingConfig?.outputMappings || [];\n\n      const baseContent = await this.resolveBaseContent(conversation, dto);\n      const conversationQuery = baseContent || &#96;触发子Agent：${dto.featureType}&#96;;\n\n      const conversationData = this.buildConversationData(\n        conversation,\n        conversationQuery,\n        targetSources,\n        dto\n      );\n\n      const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, effectiveInputMappings);\n\n      // 判断 targetWorkflowId 是 AI 角色 ID 还是工作流 ID\n      // AI 角色 ID 可能以 'role_' 或 'ai-role-' 开头，工作流 ID 以 'wf_' 开头\n      const isRoleId = targetWorkflowId.startsWith('role_') || targetWorkflowId.startsWith('ai-role-');\n      \n      let workflowResult;\n      if (isRoleId) {\n        // 直接调用 AI 角色\n        logger.info('检测到 AI 角色 ID，直接调用角色', { roleId: targetWorkflowId, featureType: dto.featureType });\n        workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeRole(targetWorkflowId, workflowInput);\n      } else {\n        // 通过工作流调用\n        logger.info('检测到工作流 ID，通过工作流调用', { workflowId: targetWorkflowId, featureType: dto.featureType });\n        workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(\n          targetWorkflowId,\n          { input: workflowInput }\n        );\n      }\n\n      const extractedOutput = extractWorkflowOutput(workflowResult, effectiveOutputMappings);\n\n      const aiContent = extractedOutput.content\n        || workflowResult.message\n        || &#96;子Agent ${dto.featureType} 已执行&#96;;\n\n      const messageOutputs = {\n        ...extractedOutput,\n,\n      };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 字段映射引擎\n */\nexport class FieldMappingEngine {\n  /**\n   * 将对话数据转换为工作流输入\n   * @param conversationData 对话数据\n   * @param mappingRules 字段映射规则\n   * @returns 工作流输入对象\n   */\n  mapInputFields(\n    conversationData: ConversationData,\n    mappingRules: FieldMappingRule[]\n  ): Record&lt;string, any&gt; {\n    const workflowInput: Record&lt;string, any&gt; = {};\n\n    for (const rule of mappingRules) {\n      let value: any;\n\n      if (rule.sourceType === 'field') {\n        // 字段映射：直接从对话数据提取字段\n        if (rule.sourceField === 'query') {\n          value = conversationData.query;\n        } else if (rule.sourceField === 'sources') {\n          value = conversationData.sources || [];\n        } else if (rule.sourceField === 'files') {\n          value = conversationData.files || [];\n        } else if (rule.sourceField === 'history') {\n          value = conversationData.history || [];\n        } else if (rule.sourceField === 'lastAssistantMessage') {\n          value = conversationData.lastAssistantMessage;\n        } else if (rule.sourceField === 'lastUserMessage') {\n          value = conversationData.lastUserMessage;\n        } else if (rule.sourceField === 'conversationId') {\n          value = conversationData.conversationId;\n        } else if (rule.sourceField === 'featureType') {\n          value = conversationData.featureType;\n        } else {\n          value = undefined;\n        }\n\n        // 如果值为空且提供了默认值，使用默认值\n        if ((value === undefined || value === null || value === '') &amp;&amp; rule.defaultValue !== undefined) {\n          value = rule.defaultValue;\n        }\n      } else if (rule.sourceType === 'expression') {\n        // 表达式映射：执行JavaScript表达式\n        try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const FieldMappingManagementPage: React.FC = \n() =&gt; {\n\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const loadExistingConfig = async () =&gt; {\n      try {\n        // 字段映射管理只关联技术包装页面\n        const targetPageType = 'tech-package';\n\n        // 加载所有映射配置\n        const mappingsData = await aiSearchService.getAllFieldMappingConfigs();\n        console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 加载的映射配置数量:', mappingsData.length, 'targetPageType:', targetPageType);\n        \n        console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 查找 pageType:', targetPageType);\n        \n        // 查找技术包装页面对应的第一个工作流配置\n        for (const mapping of mappingsData) {\n          const featureObjects = Array.isArray(mapping.config?.featureObjects) \n            ? mapping.config.featureObjects \n            : [];\n          \n          const hasMatchingPageType = featureObjects.some((f: any) =&gt; \n            f.pageType === targetPageType\n          );\n          \n          if (hasMatchingPageType) {\n            console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 找到匹配的配置:', mapping.workflowId);\n            setSelectedWorkflowId(mapping.workflowId);\n            // 尝试将workflowId匹配到AI角色\n            const matchingRole = roles.find((r: any) =&gt; r.id === mapping.workflowId);\n            if (matchingRole &amp;&amp; matchingRole.enabled) {\n              setSelectedRoleIdForMapping(mapping.workflowId);\n            }\n            // 如果找不到匹配的角色，保持workflowId不变，但selectedRoleIdForMapping为空，用户需要手动选择\n            \n            // 加载技术包装页面已配置的 AI 模块\n            const configuredFeatures = featureObjects\n              .filter((f: any) =&gt; f.pageType === targetPageType)\n              .map((f: any) =&gt; f.featureType);\n            \n            console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 已配置的 AI 模块:', configuredFeatures);\n            \n            if (configuredFeatures.length &gt; 0) {\n              setSelectedFeatureTypes(configuredFeatures);\n            }\n            return; // 找到配置后直接返回\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果没有找到配置，但有AI角色，使用第一个启用的AI角色作为默认值\n;\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadEnabledToolsForPage = async (useCache = true) =&gt; {\n\n\n    isLoadingToolsRef.current = true;\n    try {\n      console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 加载工具配置，pageType:', config.pageType);\n      \n      // 1. 优先从字段映射配置中加载（字段映射配置是用户实际配置的，应该优先使用）\n      const mappings = await aiSearchService.getAllFieldMappingConfigs();\n      cachedMappingsRef.current = mappings; // 缓存映射配置\n      \n      // 向后兼容：支持读取旧数据中的 'speech'，但新数据统一使用 'press-release'\n      const pageKeys = config.pageType === 'press-release' \n        ? ['press-release', 'speech'] \n        : [config.pageType];\n      console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 从字段映射配置加载工具，pageKeys:', pageKeys, 'mappings数量:', mappings.length);\n      \n      const setIds = new Set&lt;string&gt;();\n      const labels: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {};\n      \n      // 从所有字段映射配置中筛选匹配当前 pageType 的工具项\n      // 这样可以聚合所有工作流中配置的该页面的工具\n      for (const item of mappings) {\n        const fos = Array.isArray(item.config?.featureObjects) ? item.config.featureObjects : [];\n        for (const f of fos) {\n          // 排除 ai-dialog，检查是否匹配当前页面的 pageType\n          if (f.featureType &amp;&amp; f.featureType !== 'ai-dialog') {\n            const featurePageType = (f as any).pageType;\n            // 如果 featureObject 有 pageType，必须匹配当前页面；如果没有 pageType，则不显示（避免显示不相关的工具）\n            if (featurePageType &amp;&amp; pageKeys.includes(featurePageType)) {\n              setIds.add(f.featureType);\n              // 如果多个工作流配置了同一个工具，优先使用有 label 的配置\n              if ((f as any).label &amp;&amp; !labels[f.featureType]) {\n                labels[f.featureType] = (f as any).label as string;\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 如果当前工作流有配置，优先使用当前工作流的标签\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\n\n\n  async execute(conversationId: string, dto: TriggerAgentDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const conversation = await this.aiSearchService.getConversation(conversationId);\n      if (!conversation) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: '对话不存在',\n        });\n      }\n\n      const requestedWorkflowId = dto.workflowId;\n      const workflowId = requestedWorkflowId || await resolveWorkflowId();\n      if (!workflowId) {\n        return failure({\n          code: 'WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: '未找到可用的工作流配置',\n        });\n      }\n\n      let targetSources = Array.isArray(dto.sources) ? dto.sources : conversation.sources || [];\n\n      const baseMappingConfig = await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, workflowId);\n      if (!baseMappingConfig) {\n        const message =\n          requestedWorkflowId &amp;&amp; requestedWorkflowId === workflowId\n            ? &#96;所选工作流(${workflowId})尚未配置字段映射&#96;\n            : '尚未配置字段映射，请先完成字段映射配置';\n        return failure({\n          code: 'MAPPING_NOT_FOUND',\n          message,\n        });\n      }\n\n      const featureConfig = baseMappingConfig.featureObjects?.find(\n        (f: FeatureObjectMapping) =&gt; f.featureType === dto.featureType\n      );\n\n      // 调试日志：检查功能对象配置\n      logger.info('查找功能对象配置', {\n        featureType: dto.featureType,\n        allFeatureObjects: baseMappingConfig.featureObjects?.map((f: any) =&gt; ({\n          featureType: f.featureType,\n          workflowId: f.workflowId,\n          pageType: f.pageType,\n        })),\n        foundConfig: featureConfig ? {\n          featureType: featureConfig.featureType,\n          workflowId: featureConfig.workflowId,\n        } : null,\n      });\n\n      if (!featureConfig) {\n        return\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const FieldMappingManagementPage: React.FC = \nasync () =&gt; {\n\n\n                    console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 修改配置:', {\n                      roleId: roleIdToUse,\n                      workflowId: workflowIdToUse,\n                      pageType: selectedPageType,\n                      features: featuresToBind,\n                      association: &#96;为 ${PAGE_LABELS[selectedPageType]} 页面关联 ${featuresToBind.length} 个AI模块&#96;,\n                    });\n\n                    const existing = await aiSearchService.getFieldMappingConfig(workflowIdToUse);\n                    const normalizedPageType = selectedPageType;\n                    let nextConfig: FieldMappingConfig;\n                    \n                    if (existing) {\n                      const fo = Array.isArray(existing.featureObjects) ? existing.featureObjects.slice() : [];\n                      \n                      // 修改逻辑：只修改当前 pageType 的配置，完全保留其他 pageType 的配置\n                      // 1. 保留所有其他 pageType 的配置（确保其他页面配置不受影响）\n                      const otherPageTypeFeatures = fo.filter((f: any) =&gt; {\n                        // 保留没有 pageType 的配置（向后兼容）\n                        if (!f.pageType) {\n                          return true;\n                        }\n                        // 保留所有不是当前 pageType 的配置\n                        return f.pageType !== normalizedPageType;\n                      });\n                      \n                      console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 保留的其他 pageType 配置数量:', otherPageTypeFeatures.length);\n                      console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 保留的其他 pageType 配置:', otherPageTypeFeatures.map((f: any) =&gt; ({\n                        featureType: f.featureType,\n                        pageType: f.pageType,\n                        label: f.label\n                      })));\n                      \n                      // 2. 为当前 pageType 创建新的配置（基于用户选择）\n                }\n;",

        "contents": "const FieldMappingManagementPage: React.FC = \nasync () =&gt; {\n\n                      \n                      console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 最终配置的 featureObjects 数量:', nextConfig.featureObjects?.length);\n                      console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 最终配置的 featureObjects:', nextConfig.featureObjects?.map((f: any) =&gt; ({\n                        featureType: f.featureType,\n                        pageType: f.pageType,\n                        label: f.label\n                      })));\n                    } else {\n                      // 如果没有现有配置，创建新配置\n                      const featureObjects = featuresToBind.map(ft =&gt; {\n                        // 查找自定义模块的标签\n                        const customModule = customModules.find(m =&gt; m.id === ft);\n                        const moduleLabel = customModule?.label || FEATURE_LABELS[ft] || undefined;\n                        \n                        return {\n                          featureType: ft as any,\n                          workflowId: workflowIdToUse,\n                          inputMappings: [],\n                          outputMappings: [],\n                          pageType: normalizedPageType,\n                          label: moduleLabel,\n                        };\n                      });\n                      \n                      nextConfig = {\n                        workflowId: workflowIdToUse,\n                        inputMappings: [],\n                        outputMappings: [],\n                        featureObjects,\n                      } as any;\n                    }\n\n                    console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 保存配置:', nextConfig);\n                    await aiSearchService.saveFieldMappingConfig(workflowIdToUse, nextConfig);\n                    \n                    setMessage({ type: 'success', text: &#96;配置修改成功：已为 ${PAGE_LABELS[normalizedPageType]} 页面更新为 ${featuresToBind.length} 个AI模块&#96; });\n                    setShowCreateModal(false);\n                    // 重置表单状态（但保留自定义模块，因为它们应该持久化显示）\n                    setSelectedFeatureTypes([]);\n                    setSelectedFeatureType('');\n                }\n;",

        "contents": "const FieldMappingManagementPage: React.FC = \nconst handleDelete = async \n\n\n    try {\n      const deleteKey = &#96;${mapping.workflowId}-${mapping.pageType || 'no-page'}-${mapping.featureType}&#96;;\n      setDeletingId(deleteKey);\n      \n      // 获取现有配置\n      const existing = await aiSearchService.getFieldMappingConfig(mapping.workflowId);\n      \n      if (!existing) {\n        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '配置不存在' });\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const featureObjects = Array.isArray(existing.featureObjects) ? existing.featureObjects.slice() : [];\n      \n      // 移除匹配的 featureObject（根据 featureType 和 pageType）\n      const filteredFeatureObjects = featureObjects.filter((f: any) =&gt; {\n        // 如果当前配置有 pageType，必须同时匹配 featureType 和 pageType\n        if (mapping.pageType) {\n          return !(f.featureType === mapping.featureType &amp;&amp; f.pageType === mapping.pageType);\n        }\n        // 如果当前配置没有 pageType（向后兼容），只匹配 featureType\n        return f.featureType !== mapping.featureType;\n      });\n\n      // 如果还有其他的 featureObjects，更新配置；否则删除整个配置\n      if (filteredFeatureObjects.length &gt; 0) {\n        const updatedConfig: FieldMappingConfig = {\n          ...existing,\n          featureObjects: filteredFeatureObjects,\n        };\n        await aiSearchService.saveFieldMappingConfig(mapping.workflowId, updatedConfig);\n        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: '删除成功' });\n      } else {\n        // 如果没有其他配置了，删除整个配置记录\n        await aiSearchService.deleteFieldMappingConfig(mapping.workflowId);\n        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: '删除成功' });\n      }\n      \n      await loadData();\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('删除失败:', error);\n      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '删除失败，请稍后重试' });\n    } finally {\n      setDeletingId(null);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const openAgentModal = (mapping: FieldMappingListItem) =&gt;\n;\n;",

已修改 DialogueContent 组件，使发送消息时优先使用字段映射配置中的 agentId（针对 ai-dialog featureType 和 tech-package pageType），若无则使用 localStorage 中保存的角色 ID。

主要修改：
1. **优先使用字段映射配置**：在技术包装页面，发送消息前会查找字段映射配置中 `ai-dialog` featureType 且 `pageType` 为 `tech-package` 的配置，如果配置了 `agentId`，则使用它。
2. **回退到 localStorage**：如果字段映射配置中没有找到 agentId，则使用 localStorage 中保存的角色 ID（通过"配置AI角色"按钮选择后保存）。
3. **最后使用传入的 workflowId**：如果以上都没有，则使用传入的 `workflowId`。

现在，在技术包装页面通过"配置AI角色"按钮选择的 AI 角色会被应用到对话中。如果字段映射管理页面为 AI 对话配置了 agentId，会优先使用该配置。

已在 StudioSidebar 组件中添加“更多”按钮和字段映射配置弹窗。主要修改：

   - 保存配置到字段映射管理

        "contents": "const FieldMappingManagementPage: React.FC = \nconst loadData = async \n // 用于去重\n      \n      for (const mapping of mappingsData) {\n        const featureObjects = Array.isArray(mapping.config.featureObjects)\n          ? mapping.config.featureObjects\n          : [];\n        if (featureObjects.length &gt; 0) {\n          for (const feature of featureObjects) {\n            const workflowId = feature.workflowId || mapping.workflowId;\n            const workflow = workflowsData.find((w) =&gt; w.id === workflowId);\n            const pageType = feature.pageType;\n            const featureType = feature.featureType;\n            \n            // 创建唯一键：workflowId + pageType + featureType\n            const uniqueKey = &#96;${workflowId}-${pageType || 'no-page'}-${featureType}&#96;;\n            \n            // 如果已经存在相同的配置，跳过（去重）\n            if (seenKeys.has(uniqueKey)) {\n              console.warn('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 发现重复配置，已跳过:', {\n                workflowId,\n                pageType,\n                featureType,\n                uniqueKey\n              });\n              continue;\n            }\n            \n            seenKeys.add(uniqueKey);\n            \n            // 尝试从工作流或AI角色中获取名称\n            let displayName = workflow?.name;\n            if (!displayName) {\n              // 如果找不到工作流，尝试从AI角色中查找\n              const role = rolesData.find((r: any) =&gt; r.id === workflowId);\n              displayName = role?.name || '未知配置';\n            }\n            \n            rows.push({\n              ...mapping,\n              workflowId\n\n;\n;",

        "contents": "/**\n * 保存字段映射配置\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/field-mappings/:workflowId\n */\nrouter.post('/field-mappings/:workflowId', ensureTablesInitialized, async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { workflowId } = req.params;\n    const dto = validateDTO(SaveFieldMappingSchema, req.body);\n    const result = await saveFieldMappingConfigUseCase.execute(workflowId, dto);\n\n    if (!result.success) {\n      const status = result.error.code === 'WORKFLOW_ID_MISMATCH' ? 400 : 500;\n      return res.status(status).json(\n        formatApiResponse(false, null, '保存字段映射配置失败', result.error.message)\n      );\n    }\n\n    res.json(formatApiResponse(true, result.value, '保存字段映射配置成功'));\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof ValidationException) {\n      const failure = formatValidationFailure(error);\n      return res.status(400).json(failure);\n    }\n\n    logger.error('保存字段映射配置失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        false,\n        null,\n        '保存字段映射配置失败',\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n      )\n    );\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 删除字段映射配置\n * DELETE /api/v1/ai-search/field-mappings/:workflowId\n */",

        "contents": "const FieldMappingManagementPage: React.FC = \n() =&gt; {\n\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const loadExistingConfig = async () =&gt; {\n      try {\n        // 字段映射管理只关联技术包装页面\n        const targetPageType = 'tech-package';\n\n        // 加载所有映射配置\n        const mappingsData = await aiSearchService.getAllFieldMappingConfigs();\n        console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 加载的映射配置数量:', mappingsData.length, 'targetPageType:', targetPageType);\n        \n        console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 查找 pageType:', targetPageType);\n        \n        // 查找技术包装页面对应的第一个工作流配置\n        for (const mapping of mappingsData) {\n          const featureObjects = Array.isArray(mapping.config?.featureObjects) \n            ? mapping.config.featureObjects \n            : [];\n          \n          const hasMatchingPageType = featureObjects.some((f: any) =&gt; \n            f.pageType === targetPageType\n          );\n          \n          if (hasMatchingPageType) {\n            console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 找到匹配的配置:', mapping.workflowId);\n            setSelectedWorkflowId(mapping.workflowId);\n            // 尝试将workflowId匹配到AI角色\n            const matchingRole = roles.find((r: any) =&gt; r.id === mapping.workflowId);\n            if (matchingRole &amp;&amp; matchingRole.enabled) {\n              setSelectedRoleIdForMapping(mapping.workflowId);\n            }\n            // 如果找不到匹配的角色，保持workflowId不变，但selectedRoleIdForMapping为空，用户需要手动选择\n            \n            // 加载技术包装页面已配置的 AI 模块\n            const configuredFeatures = featureObjects\n              .filter((f: any) =&gt; f.pageType === targetPageType)\n              .map((f: any) =&gt; f.featureType);\n            \n            console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 已配置的 AI 模块:', configuredFeatures);\n            \n            if (configuredFeatures.length &gt; 0) {\n              setSelectedFeatureTypes(configuredFeatures);\n            }\n            return; // 找到配置后直接返回\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果没有找到配置，但有AI角色，使用第一个启用的AI角色作为默认值\n;\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "// 工作流定义表\nmodel WorkflowDefinition {\n  id              String   @id @default(cuid())\n  name            String\n  type            String   // 'speech_writing' | 'ip_mining' | 'tech_article'\n  difyWorkflowId  String   @map(\"dify_workflow_id\")\n  version         String   @default(\"1.0.0\")\n  isActive        Boolean  @default(true) @map(\"is_active\")\n  description     String?\n  config          String   // JSON配置\n  createdAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map(\"created_at\")\n  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt @map(\"updated_at\")\n  \n  fieldMappings   FieldMapping[]\n  tasks          Task[]\n  \n  @@map(\"workflow_definitions\")\n  @@unique([type, version])\n  @@index([type, isActive])\n}\n\n// 字段映射表\nmodel FieldMapping {\n  id              String   @id @default(cuid())\n  workflowId      String   @map(\"workflow_id\")\n  frontendField   String   @map(\"frontend_field\")\n  internalField   String   @map(\"internal_field\")\n  difyField       String   @map(\"dify_field\")\n  fieldType       String   @map(\"field_type\")\n  isRequired      Boolean  @default(false) @map(\"is_required\")\n  defaultValue    String?  @map(\"default_value\")\n  options         String?  // JSON数组\n  validation      String?  // JSON验证规则\n  order           Int      @default(0)\n  createdAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map(\"created_at\")\n  \n  workflow        WorkflowDefinition @relation(fields: [workflowId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n  \n  @@map(\"field_mappings\")\n  @@unique([workflowId, frontendField])\n  @@unique([workflowId, internalField])\n  @@index([workflowId, order])\n}\n\n// 任务表 (扩展现有的AnalysisTask)\nmodel Task {\n  id              String   @id @default(cuid())",

        "contents": "const FieldMappingManagementPage: React.FC = \nconst openAgentModal = \n\n  };\n\n  const saveAgentRole = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!editingMappingForAgent) return;\n    try {\n      const existing = await aiSearchService.getFieldMappingConfig(editingMappingForAgent.workflowId);\n      if (!existing) {\n        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '配置不存在' });\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const pageType = editingMappingForAgent.pageName === '技术包装' ? 'tech-package' :\n                      editingMappingForAgent.pageName === '技术策略' ? 'tech-strategy' :\n                      editingMappingForAgent.pageName === '技术通稿' ? 'tech-article' :\n                      editingMappingForAgent.pageName === '发布稿' || editingMappingForAgent.pageName === '发布会稿' ? 'press-release' : undefined;\n\n      const featureObjects = Array.isArray(existing.featureObjects) ? existing.featureObjects.slice() : [];\n      // 根据 featureType 和 pageType 查找配置，避免覆盖其他 pageType 的配置\n      const featureIndex = featureObjects.findIndex((f: any) =&gt; \n        f.featureType === editingMappingForAgent.featureType &amp;&amp; \n        (pageType ? f.pageType === pageType : true) // 如果提供了 pageType，必须匹配\n      );\n      \n      if (featureIndex &gt;= 0) {\n        // 更新现有featureObject的agentId\n        featureObjects[featureIndex] = {\n          ...featureObjects[featureIndex],\n          agentId: selectedAgentId || undefined,\n        };\n      } else {\n        // 如果不存在，创建一个新的featureObject\n        featureObjects.push({\n          featureType: editingMappingForAgent.featureType as any,\n          workflowId: editingMappingForAgent.workflowId,\n          inputMappings: [],\n          outputMappings: [],\n          pageType: pageType as 'tech-package' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article' | 'press-release' | undefined,\n          label: editingMappingForAgent.featureLabel,\n          agentId: selectedAgentId || undefined,\n        });\n      }\n\n      const updatedConfig: FieldMappingConfig = {\n        ...existing,\n,\n      };\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const FieldMappingManagementPage: React.FC = \nconst handleDelete = async \n\n\n    try {\n      const deleteKey = &#96;${mapping.workflowId}-${mapping.pageType || 'no-page'}-${mapping.featureType}&#96;;\n      setDeletingId(deleteKey);\n      \n      // 获取现有配置\n      const existing = await aiSearchService.getFieldMappingConfig(mapping.workflowId);\n      \n      if (!existing) {\n        setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '配置不存在' });\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const featureObjects = Array.isArray(existing.featureObjects) ? existing.featureObjects.slice() : [];\n      \n      // 移除匹配的 featureObject（根据 featureType 和 pageType）\n      const filteredFeatureObjects = featureObjects.filter((f: any) =&gt; {\n        // 如果当前配置有 pageType，必须同时匹配 featureType 和 pageType\n        if (mapping.pageType) {\n          return !(f.featureType === mapping.featureType &amp;&amp; f.pageType === mapping.pageType);\n        }\n        // 如果当前配置没有 pageType（向后兼容），只匹配 featureType\n        return f.featureType !== mapping.featureType;\n      });\n\n      // 如果还有其他的 featureObjects，更新配置；否则删除整个配置\n      if (filteredFeatureObjects.length &gt; 0) {\n        const updatedConfig: FieldMappingConfig = {\n          ...existing,\n          featureObjects: filteredFeatureObjects,\n        };\n        await aiSearchService.saveFieldMappingConfig(mapping.workflowId, updatedConfig);\n        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: '删除成功' });\n      } else {\n        // 如果没有其他配置了，删除整个配置记录\n        await aiSearchService.deleteFieldMappingConfig(mapping.workflowId);\n        setMessage({ type: 'success', text: '删除成功' });\n      }\n      \n      await loadData();\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('删除失败:', error);\n      setMessage({ type: 'error', text: '删除失败，请稍后重试' });\n    } finally {\n      setDeletingId(null);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const openAgentModal = (mapping: FieldMappingListItem) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadEnabledToolsForPage = async (useCache = true) =&gt; {\n\n      \n      // 如果当前工作流有配置，优先使用当前工作流的标签\n      if (selectedWorkflowId) {\n        const currentMapping = mappings.find(m =&gt; m.workflowId === selectedWorkflowId);\n        if (currentMapping) {\n          const fos = Array.isArray(currentMapping.config?.featureObjects) ? currentMapping.config.featureObjects : [];\n          for (const f of fos) {\n            if (f.featureType &amp;&amp; f.featureType !== 'ai-dialog') {\n              const featurePageType = (f as any).pageType;\n              if (featurePageType &amp;&amp; pageKeys.includes(featurePageType)) {\n                if ((f as any).label) {\n                  labels[f.featureType] = (f as any).label as string;\n                }\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      \n      console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 从字段映射配置找到的工具数量:', setIds.size, '工具列表:', Array.from(setIds));\n      \n      // 如果字段映射配置中有工具，优先使用字段映射配置\n      if (setIds.size &gt; 0) {\n        const toolIds = Array.from(setIds);\n        setEnabledToolIds(prev =&gt; areArraysEqual(prev, toolIds) ? prev : toolIds);\n        setDynamicLabelMap(prev =&gt; areObjectsEqual(prev, labels) ? prev : labels);\n        // 缓存工具ID\n        cachedToolIdsRef.current[config.pageType] = toolIds;\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 2. 如果字段映射配置中没有工具，尝试从数据库加载页面工具配置\n      const dbConfig = await pageToolConfigService.getByPageType(config.pageType);\n      if (dbConfig &amp;&amp; dbConfig.enabledToolIds &amp;&amp; dbConfig.enabledToolIds.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log\n  };\n;",

        },
        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadEnabledToolsForPage = async (useCache = true) =&gt; {\n\n\n    isLoadingToolsRef.current = true;\n    try {\n      console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 加载工具配置，pageType:', config.pageType);\n      \n      // 1. 优先从字段映射配置中加载（字段映射配置是用户实际配置的，应该优先使用）\n      const mappings = await aiSearchService.getAllFieldMappingConfigs();\n      cachedMappingsRef.current = mappings; // 缓存映射配置\n      \n      // 向后兼容：支持读取旧数据中的 'speech'，但新数据统一使用 'press-release'\n      const pageKeys = config.pageType === 'press-release' \n        ? ['press-release', 'speech'] \n        : [config.pageType];\n      console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 从字段映射配置加载工具，pageKeys:', pageKeys, 'mappings数量:', mappings.length);\n      \n      const setIds = new Set&lt;string&gt;();\n      const labels: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {};\n      \n      // 从所有字段映射配置中筛选匹配当前 pageType 的工具项\n      // 这样可以聚合所有工作流中配置的该页面的工具\n      for (const item of mappings) {\n        const fos = Array.isArray(item.config?.featureObjects) ? item.config.featureObjects : [];\n        for (const f of fos) {\n          // 排除 ai-dialog，检查是否匹配当前页面的 pageType\n          if (f.featureType &amp;&amp; f.featureType !== 'ai-dialog') {\n            const featurePageType = (f as any).pageType;\n            // 如果 featureObject 有 pageType，必须匹配当前页面；如果没有 pageType，则不显示（避免显示不相关的工具）\n            if (featurePageType &amp;&amp; pageKeys.includes(featurePageType)) {\n              setIds.add(f.featureType);\n              // 如果多个工作流配置了同一个工具，优先使用有 label 的配置\n              if ((f as any).label &amp;&amp; !labels[f.featureType]) {\n                labels[f.featureType] = (f as any).label as string;\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 如果当前工作流有配置，优先使用当前工作流的标签\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadEnabledToolsForPage = (async (useCache = true) =&gt; {\n    // 如果正在加载，避免重复请求\n    if (isLoadingToolsRef.current &amp;&amp; useCache) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // 如果有缓存，先立即使用缓存显示，提升用户体验\n    const hasCache = cachedToolIdsRef.current[config.pageType];\n    if (useCache &amp;&amp; hasCache) {\n      const cachedToolIds = cachedToolIdsRef.current[config.pageType];\n      console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 使用缓存工具配置，pageType:', config.pageType, '工具数量:', cachedToolIds.length);\n      setEnabledToolIds(prev =&gt; areArraysEqual(prev, cachedToolIds) ? prev : cachedToolIds);\n      // 如果有缓存的映射配置，也可以使用缓存的标签\n      if (cachedMappingsRef.current.length &gt; 0) {\n        const pageKeys = config.pageType === 'press-release' \n          ? ['press-release', 'speech'] \n          : [config.pageType];\n        const labels: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {};\n        for (const item of cachedMappingsRef.current) {\n          const fos = Array.isArray(item.config?.featureObjects) ? item.config.featureObjects : [];\n          for (const f of fos) {\n            if (f.featureType &amp;&amp; f.featureType !== 'ai-dialog') {\n              const featurePageType = (f as any).pageType;\n              if (featurePageType &amp;&amp; pageKeys.includes(featurePageType)) {\n                if ((f as any).label &amp;&amp; !labels[f.featureType]) {\n                  labels[f.featureType] = (f as any).label as string;\n                }\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        if (Object.keys(labels).length &gt; 0) {\n          setDynamicLabelMap(prev =&gt; areObjectsEqual(prev, labels) ? prev : labels);\n        }\n      }\n      // 继续在后台更新，但不阻塞UI\n    }\n\n    isLoadingToolsRef.current = true;\n    try {\n      console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 加载工具配置，pageType:',\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadEnabledToolsForPage = async (useCache = true) =&gt; {\nconst ;\n      if (dbConfig &amp;&amp; dbConfig.enabledToolIds &amp;&amp; dbConfig.enabledToolIds.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 字段映射配置为空，从数据库配置加载工具:', dbConfig.enabledToolIds);\n        setEnabledToolIds(prev =&gt; areArraysEqual(prev, dbConfig.enabledToolIds) ? prev : dbConfig.enabledToolIds);\n        setDynamicLabelMap(prev =&gt; areObjectsEqual(prev, dbConfig.featureLabelMap || {}) ? prev : (dbConfig.featureLabelMap || {}));\n        // 缓存工具ID\n        cachedToolIdsRef.current[config.pageType] = dbConfig.enabledToolIds;\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 3. 如果都没有，回退到使用配置中的默认工具列表\n      console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 未找到字段映射配置和数据库配置，使用默认配置:', config.enabledToolIds);\n      const defaultToolIds = config.enabledToolIds || [];\n      setEnabledToolIds(prev =&gt; areArraysEqual(prev, defaultToolIds) ? prev : defaultToolIds);\n      setDynamicLabelMap(prev =&gt; areObjectsEqual(prev, {}) ? prev : {});\n      // 缓存默认工具ID\n      cachedToolIdsRef.current[config.pageType] = defaultToolIds;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[BaseAISearchPage] 加载工具配置失败:', error);\n      // 出错时也回退到使用配置中的默认工具列表（只有在没有缓存时才设置）\n      if (!cachedToolIdsRef.current[config.pageType]) {\n        const defaultToolIds = config.enabledToolIds || [];\n        setEnabledToolIds(prev =&gt; areArraysEqual(prev, defaultToolIds) ? prev : defaultToolIds);\n        setDynamicLabelMap(prev =&gt; areObjectsEqual(prev, {}) ? prev : {});\n        cachedToolIdsRef.current[config.pageType] = defaultToolIds;\n      }\n    } finally {\n      isLoadingToolsRef.current = false;\n    }\n  }, [config.pageType, config.enabledToolIds, selectedWorkflowId]);\n\n  // 只在pageType改变时加载工具配置（包括API请求）\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadEnabledToolsForPage();\n  }, [loadEnabledToolsForPage]);\n\n  // 监听页面可见性和焦点变化，当页面重新获得焦点时重新加载工具配置\n;",

        "contents": "const StudioSidebar: React.FC&lt;StudioSidebarProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 使用 useMemo 优化工具项的计算，避免每次渲染都重新计算\n  const toolItems = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    // 所有可用的工具项\n    const allToolItems = [\n      {\n        id: 'five-view-analysis',\n        label: featureLabelMap['five-view-analysis'] || '技术转译',\n        icon: Eye,\n      },\n      {\n        id: 'three-fix-analysis',\n        label: featureLabelMap['three-fix-analysis'] || '用户场景挖掘',\n        icon: Target,\n      },\n      {\n        id: 'tech-matrix',\n        label: featureLabelMap['tech-matrix'] || '发布会场景化',\n        icon: Grid,\n      },\n      {\n        id: 'propagation-strategy',\n        label: featureLabelMap['propagation-strategy'] || '领导人口语化',\n        icon: Megaphone,\n      },\n      {\n        id: 'exhibition-video',\n        label: featureLabelMap['exhibition-video'] || '展具与视频',\n        icon: Video,\n      },\n      {\n        id: 'translation',\n        label: featureLabelMap['translation'] || '翻译',\n        icon: Languages,\n      },\n      {\n        id: 'ppt-outline',\n        label: featureLabelMap['ppt-outline'] || '技术讲稿',\n        icon: Presentation,\n      },\n      {\n        id: 'script',\n        label: featureLabelMap['script'] || '脚本',\n        icon: FileText,\n      },\n    ];\n\n    // 扩展：为未在静态列表中的启用ID生成通用工具项\n    const staticFiltered = enabledToolIds\n      ? allToolItems.filter(item =&gt; enabledToolIds.includes(item.id))\n      : allToolItems;\n\n    const unknownIds = (enabledToolIds || []).filter(id =&gt; !allToolItems.some(item =&gt; item.id === id));\n    const unknownItems = unknownIds.map(id =&gt; ({\n      id,\n      label: featureLabelMap[id] || id,\n      icon: FileText,\n    }));\n\n    return enabledToolIds ? [...staticFiltered, ...unknownItems] : staticFiltered;\n  }, [enabledToolIds, featureLabelMap]);\n\n  return\n;",

        "contents": "-- 页面工具配置相关数据库表\n-- 用于管理每个页面可用的工具列表和标签映射\n\n-- 页面工具配置表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS page_tool_configs (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    page_type TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,  -- 页面类型: 'tech-package', 'press-release', 'tech-strategy', 'tech-article'\n    page_title TEXT NOT NULL,         -- 页面标题\n    dialogue_title TEXT NOT NULL,     -- 对话标题\n    studio_title TEXT NOT NULL,       -- Studio侧边栏标题\n    workflow_selection_key TEXT NOT NULL,  -- 工作流选择键\n    enabled_tool_ids TEXT,            -- JSON数组，启用的工具ID列表\n    feature_label_map TEXT,           -- JSON对象，功能标签映射\n    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,     -- 0或1，是否启用\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_page_tool_configs_page_type ON page_tool_configs(page_type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_page_tool_configs_active ON page_tool_configs(is_active);\n\n-- 创建触发器，自动更新updated_at字段\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS update_page_tool_configs_updated_at\nAFTER UPDATE ON page_tool_configs\nBEGIN\n    UPDATE page_tool_configs SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\nEND;\n\n-- 插入默认配置数据（使用INSERT OR REPLACE for SQLite，或使用ON CONFLICT for PostgreSQL）\n-- SQLite版本\nINSERT OR REPLACE INTO page_tool_configs (\n    id,\n    page_type,\n    page_title,\n    dialogue_title,\n    studio_title,\n    workflow_selection_key,\n    enabled_tool_ids,\n    feature_label_map,\n    is_active\n) VALUES\n-- 技术包装页面配置\n(\n    'tech-package-default',\n    'tech-package',\n    '技术包装',",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "const FieldMappingManagementPage: React.FC = \n() =&gt; {\nconst loadExistingConfig = async \n\n        \n        // 如果没有找到配置，但有AI角色，使用第一个启用的AI角色作为默认值\n        const enabledRoles = roles.filter((r: any) =&gt; r.enabled);\n        if (enabledRoles.length &gt; 0) {\n          console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 使用默认AI角色:', enabledRoles[0].id);\n          setSelectedRoleIdForMapping(enabledRoles[0].id);\n          setSelectedWorkflowId(enabledRoles[0].id);\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 加载配置信息失败:', error);\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadExistingConfig();\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\n  }, [showCreateModal, roles]);\n  \n  // 当\"添加工具\"弹窗打开时，加载已配置的模块信息\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (!showAddToolModal) {\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    const loadExistingModules = async () =&gt; {\n      try {\n        const enabledRoles = roles.filter((r: any) =&gt; r.enabled);\n        if (enabledRoles.length === 0) return;\n\n        const roleId = enabledRoles[0].id;\n        const mappingsData = await aiSearchService.getAllFieldMappingConfigs();\n        \n        for (const mapping of mappingsData) {\n          if (mapping.workflowId === roleId) {\n            const featureObjects = Array.isArray(mapping.config?.featureObjects) \n              ? mapping.config.featureObjects \n              : [];\n            \n            const configuredFeatures = featureObjects\n              .filter((f: any) =&gt; f.pageType === 'tech-package')\n              .map((f: any) =&gt; f.featureType);\n            \n            // 不自动选中已配置的模块，让用户手动选择要添加的新模块\n            return;\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('加载配置信息失败:', error);\n      }\n    };\n    \n    if (roles.length &gt; 0) {\n      loadExistingModules();\n    }\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\n  }, [showAddToolModal, roles]);\n\n  const handleDelete = async (mapping: FieldMappingListItem)\n;\n;",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./frontend/src/pages/FieldMappingManagementPage.tsx",
        "range": {

        "contents": "const FieldMappingManagementPage: React.FC = \n() =&gt; {\n\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const loadExistingConfig = async () =&gt; {\n      try {\n        // 字段映射管理只关联技术包装页面\n        const targetPageType = 'tech-package';\n\n        // 加载所有映射配置\n        const mappingsData = await aiSearchService.getAllFieldMappingConfigs();\n        console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 加载的映射配置数量:', mappingsData.length, 'targetPageType:', targetPageType);\n        \n        console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 查找 pageType:', targetPageType);\n        \n        // 查找技术包装页面对应的第一个工作流配置\n        for (const mapping of mappingsData) {\n          const featureObjects = Array.isArray(mapping.config?.featureObjects) \n            ? mapping.config.featureObjects \n            : [];\n          \n          const hasMatchingPageType = featureObjects.some((f: any) =&gt; \n            f.pageType === targetPageType\n          );\n          \n          if (hasMatchingPageType) {\n            console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 找到匹配的配置:', mapping.workflowId);\n            setSelectedWorkflowId(mapping.workflowId);\n            // 尝试将workflowId匹配到AI角色\n            const matchingRole = roles.find((r: any) =&gt; r.id === mapping.workflowId);\n            if (matchingRole &amp;&amp; matchingRole.enabled) {\n              setSelectedRoleIdForMapping(mapping.workflowId);\n            }\n            // 如果找不到匹配的角色，保持workflowId不变，但selectedRoleIdForMapping为空，用户需要手动选择\n            \n            // 加载技术包装页面已配置的 AI 模块\n            const configuredFeatures = featureObjects\n              .filter((f: any) =&gt; f.pageType === targetPageType)\n              .map((f: any) =&gt; f.featureType);\n            \n            console.log('[FieldMappingManagementPage] 已配置的 AI 模块:', configuredFeatures);\n            \n            if (configuredFeatures.length &gt; 0) {\n              setSelectedFeatureTypes(configuredFeatures);\n            }\n            return; // 找到配置后直接返回\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果没有找到配置，但有AI角色，使用第一个启用的AI角色作为默认值\n;\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "export class PageToolConfigModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 将数据库记录转换为前端格式\n   */\n  private toPageToolConfigDTO(row: PageToolConfig): PageToolConfigDTO {\n    let enabledToolIds: string[] | undefined;\n    let featureLabelMap: Record&lt;string, string&gt; | undefined;\n\n    try {\n      if (row.enabled_tool_ids) {\n        enabledToolIds = JSON.parse(row.enabled_tool_ids);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('解析enabled_tool_ids失败:', error);\n    }\n\n    try {\n      if (row.feature_label_map) {\n        featureLabelMap = JSON.parse(row.feature_label_map);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('解析feature_label_map失败:', error);\n    }\n\n    return {\n      id: row.id,\n      pageType: row.page_type as 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article',\n      pageTitle: row.page_title,\n      dialogueTitle: row.dialogue_title,\n      studioTitle: row.studio_title,\n      workflowSelectionKey: row.workflow_selection_key,\n      enabledToolIds,\n      featureLabelMap,\n      isActive: row.is_active === 1,\n      createdAt: row.created_at ? new Date(row.created_at) : new Date(),\n      updatedAt: row.updated_at ? new Date(row.updated_at) : new Date(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据页面类型获取配置\n   */\n  async getByPageType(pageType: string): Promise&lt;PageToolConfigDTO | null&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",
